description: Read ONE of the user's OWN message conversations by thread_id, including its messages. Use it when the user wants to read a specific conversation ("what did the landlord say?") or before writing a reply that depends on what was said. Side effect: incoming messages in the thread are marked read — for a quick inbox overview or unread counts use list_conversations instead, so messages the user has not seen stay unread. Returns { thread, messages: [...] }; each message has id, sender_name, body, created_at, read_at and is_mine (true = sent by the user). Only threads the authenticated user participates in are returned; any other thread_id returns an error. Get the thread_id from list_conversations, then answer with reply_to_conversation.

thread_id.description: Conversation id (a UUID), taken from list_conversations. Example: "3f6c2a1e-8b4d-4c7a-9e21-5d0f7a6b1c34".

name: get_conversation
